title: Battle of Almenar
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Almenar", at revision 1370431731, opens: "The Battle of Almenar took place near Balaguer in Catalonia, on 27 July 1710, during the War of the Spanish Succession." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q697267, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle 27 jul 1710". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
